CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Replace drinking water

2. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

3. Best practice when working on Rhythm and Pattern Making: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   B. Practise Rhythm and Pattern Making with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm and Pattern Making.

4. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. Only the volume

5. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.

6. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   C. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

7. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Collage.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.
   C. Practise Painting and Collage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Painting and Collage.

9. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.

10. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

11. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

12. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   B. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   D. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. Best practice when working on String Musical Instruments and Drawing: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   B. Damage equipment used for String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   C. Disrupt classmates during String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   D. Practise String Musical Instruments and Drawing with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
   B. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.
   D. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.

15. Best practice when working on Weaving: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Weaving.
   B. Damage equipment used for Weaving.
   C. Practise Weaving with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Weaving.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The suggest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain String Musical Instruments and Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Collage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
